title: Moving the Mean Toward the Known Good, Not Beyond It: What Inference-Time Interventions and Weight Consolidation Buy in Open-Ended Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.28886v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What does a generation loop gain from learning on its own verified successes? In cycles of generate, verify, select and LoRA-consolidate on online bin packing, training on value-filtered candidates shifts what the model writes on held-out variants toward value (-1.7 points of excess, p=0.008; -3.1 against a random-consolidation control, p=0.004) while the best observed candidate converges to the classic heuristic's level and no further. A confirmation battery replicates the whole procedure three times, with fresh seeds and a never-consulted held-out set read exactly once: the mean was nearly identical in all three lineages (-2.0, -1.8, -1.9), and after aggregating within held-out variant all seven evaluable variants favored consolidation (p=0.008). The best observed candidate moved to the classic heuristic's level, exactly (0.021028 in all three lineages, for attract and for the random control alike), and never beyond it. A matched SFT

translated_title: 将均值推向已知的良好水平而非超越它：推理时干预与权重合并在开放式生成中能带来什么
translated_abstract: 一个生成循环能从学习自身经过验证的成功中获得什么？在针对在线装箱问题的“生成-验证-选择-LoRA合并”循环中，基于价值过滤候选样本的训练使模型在保留变体上的输出向更优价值偏移（超额量-1.7分，p=0.008；相比随机合并对照组为-3.1，p=0.004），而观察到的最佳候选收敛至经典启发式算法的水平且不再超越。一项确认实验组使用新随机种子和一个仅读取一次的从未接触过的保留集，将整个流程重复了三次：三个谱系中的均值几乎完全一致（-2.0、-1.8、-1.9），且在按保留变体内聚合后，全部七个可评估变体均支持合并方法（p=0.008）。观察到的最佳候选恰好移动到经典启发式算法的水平（三个谱系中均为0.021028，吸引条件与随机对照亦然），且从未超越该水平。一项匹配的SFT
tldr: 该研究发现在开放式生成任务中，通过“生成-验证-选择-LoRA合并”循环在自身验证成功的样本上训练，能显著提升模型输出的平均质量并经三重重复实验验证其稳健性，但最佳候选仅能收敛到经典启发式算法的水平而无法超越。
en_tdlr: Training a generation loop on its own verified successes through generate-verify-select-LoRA-consolidate cycles robustly improves the mean quality of model outputs (validated across three replications), yet the best observed candidate converges exactly to the classic heuristic's level and never beyond it.
